purpose: Permanent discovery and acquisition-source memory for Quran text, Quran translations, tafsir resources, hadith translations, and Islamic e-book applications.
rules: Keep every source permanently; append rather than replace.
Search saved sources before generic rediscovery.
Treat Arabic Quran text, translations of meanings, tafsir, recitations, and books as distinct content types.
Never infer redistribution rights from discoverability or downloadability; verify rights per item/source.
Prefer authoritative Quran text and preserve exact provenance/version/license metadata.
For translations, preserve translator, language, publisher/rightsholder, source and permission status.
Applications are discovery/indexing sources; acquisition must still resolve to the underlying official content and rights.
Each language remains an independent search lane.

quran_primary_and_text_sources.role: Quran reading, search, translations, tafsir, recitations, word-by-word resources and developer APIs

required_rechercher_behavior: For Quran queries, search Quran-specific sources before generic web discovery.
For Quran translations, search by language + translator + source, not language alone.
For Quran PDFs/mushaf scans, prefer official Quran institutions and verified digital surrogates.
For hadith translations, search HadeethEnc and relevant official language lanes before generic search.
For books advertised through an app, resolve the underlying publisher/library URL and store item-level provenance.
Do not classify a mobile application as an acquisition source unless the underlying content can be legally and technically acquired.
Record source version/date and checksum for authoritative Quran text assets where technically applicable.
